# See My Ballot

> Free, nonpartisan tool: type a US street address and see every contest and measure on your November 3, 2026 general-election ballot, with a source for every fact.

## What it covers

- Federal: US House and US Senate nominees for every district and state.
- Statewide offices and ballot measures for all 50 states plus DC.
- Voting logistics and links to official state election pages.
- County and local contests for about 100 of the largest counties. Local coverage is incomplete elsewhere.

## Per candidate

- Stated positions, each linked to a source the candidate wrote.
- Campaign finance from FEC filings: total raised, small-donor share, PAC share, top PACs, and outside spending.
- Voting record for anyone who has served in Congress: every final-passage roll call on measures that became law in their most recent Congress, plus their missed-vote rate.
- State and local contests link to each state's official campaign-finance search.

## Data sources

- US Census Geocoder for congressional, state legislative, and county districts.
- FEC API for federal candidates and campaign finance.
- House Clerk roll-call records; Senate roll calls via the Voteview mirror.
- State election offices.
- Candidate websites and questionnaires.

Every fact on the site links to its source.

## Privacy

Addresses are never stored. Only counts by state, congressional district, and county are kept.

## About

Open source under the MIT license. Built by ConvoFi (https://convofi.com). Feedback: ali@convofi.com.
